audioStudio.composer.unreachable: Server unreachable — is the backend running?
audioStudio.footer.redo.body: Reads the same text again with new random seeds: the intonation and the rhythm change with each take.
audioStudio.footer.redo.title: New takes (random seeds)
audioStudio.footer.reuse: Bring the text and settings back to the composer
audioStudio.footer.sameSeeds: Run again with the same seeds
audioStudio.footer.sameSeeds.hint: Runs again with the same seeds: gives the same take back. Useful after changing the speed or the variability, to judge their effect alone.
audioStudio.help.autoplay.body: Starts playing as soon as the synthesis is done.
audioStudio.help.instruct.body: A natural-language instruction that guides how the text is said: tone, emotion, pace, mood ("whispered", "warm, calm voice, slow pace", "enthusiastic"). It does not change the words spoken.
audioStudio.help.instruct.tip: describe a single clear intention, in few words; a few words work better than a long paragraph.
audioStudio.help.instruct.title: Style
audioStudio.help.instructDesign.body: This model has no ready-made voice: it invents the voice from your description (age, sex, timbre, tone, accent, pace). It is required. The result varies from one take to the next, a bit like a casting.
audioStudio.help.instructDesign.tip: example: "30-year-old woman, deep and calm voice, southern accent, slow pace". Keep the same description and the same seed to find a voice again.
audioStudio.help.instructDesign.title: Voice description
audioStudio.help.language.body: The language the text is written in. It sets the pronunciation and filters the voices offered (a voice is made for its language). A text in another language than the one chosen will be read with a strong accent, or even wrongly.
audioStudio.help.language.title: Language of the text
audioStudio.help.maxChars.body: A model only reads a short passage well at a time. Past its limit, the text is cut automatically into pieces (at sentences) read one after the other, then joined back: the synthesis takes longer, and the tone may vary slightly from one piece to the next.
audioStudio.help.maxChars.lead: This model reads about {0} characters in one go ({1} at most per request).
audioStudio.help.maxChars.tip: for a long text, expect several minutes of computing.
audioStudio.help.maxChars.title: Length of the text
audioStudio.help.script.body: Write each line at the start of a line, as "Name: text" (for example "Alice: Hello!" then "Marc: Hi."). As soon as at least two names are detected, you can give each character a voice (assigned automatically by default, with different voices). The name is not read. A line without a name continues the previous line, and an empty line adds a pause.
audioStudio.help.script.tip: always use exactly the same name for the same character.
audioStudio.help.script.title: Multi-voice dialogue
audioStudio.help.voice.tip: to clone a voice, use a clean clip of 10 to 30 s and only clone your own voice or that of someone who agreed to it.
audioStudio.help.voice.title: Voice
audioStudio.home.subtitle: Write a text, pick a voice — or clone your own from a few seconds of recording. Everything is computed on this machine.
audioStudio.language.title: Language of the text
audioStudio.notice.long: Very long text: it will be read piece by piece, the synthesis may take several minutes.
audioStudio.notice.needsVoice: This model clones a voice: choose or record a reference voice.
audioStudio.prompt.placeholder: The text to read aloud… ("Alice: …" / "Marc: …" for a multi-voice dialogue)
audioStudio.prompt.placeholder.design: The text to say… ("Name: line" for a dialogue)
audioStudio.send.incompatible: Model not compatible with this machine
audioStudio.suggestion.advert.label: Advert
audioStudio.suggestion.advert.text: What if your morning coffee finally tasted like holidays? Discover our slow, old-fashioned roasting. Roasted near you, enjoyed everywhere.
audioStudio.suggestion.announcement.text: Ladies and gentlemen, the train to Lyon Part-Dieu will leave in a few moments from platform 7. Please step back from the platform edge.
audioStudio.suggestion.dialogue.label: Dialogue
audioStudio.suggestion.dialogue.text:
Alice: Did you see the light this morning? It looks like it comes from another century.
Marc: I thought it was just the sunrise.
Alice: Exactly. That's what I'm saying.
audioStudio.suggestion.narration.label: Narration
audioStudio.suggestion.narration.text: Once upon a time, on the shore of a lake nobody had ever mapped, stood a small house whose chimney smoked even in midsummer. The villagers said its inhabitant spoke to the stars.
